message: 味方なら闇討ち

name: Sally
message: 「Mornin', Prez.」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zzz... Ria-chan...」

name: Sally
message: 「Wait, did you stay up all night waiting for Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」
In the end, Azel never came back.

name: Sally
message: 「She's probably out smashing windows all over the place. Sounds fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why windows?」

name: Sally
message: 「Roro-chi said staying out all night makes you a delinquent, and delinquents smash windows.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel wouldn't do that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good morning!」

name: Sally
message: 「Soba!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What?! I'm eatin'!」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa! Two pandas!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do I really look that sleep-deprived?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've got huge dark circles under your eyes.」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh yeah! Since Azel's not here... that means there'll be extra soba!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll eat it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Show a little concern, will you.」

name: Sally
message: 「Going a hundred years without seeing someone you know is totally normal, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's only because you're a demon.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh... this digital camera.」
Sitting all alone on the kitchen table was the digital camera the Student Council had entrusted to Azel.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry for carelessly promising that she'd come back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it really because I'm the Demon Lord...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I told you, that's not it!」
This isn't the first time Azel has vanished.
Even before, she once lied about staying over at Melilot-san's place.
Still, leaving her digital camera behind...

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama. Ditch that heartless woman and let's go find a new love.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure there must be some reason--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel isn't that kind of girl!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch. Soba. You've got a personality that only loses out.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hamapu!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up.」
I told everyone what I had told Nanaka.

name: Ria
message: 「It's true... I feel an incredible power...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'd heard about it, but... this is amazing.」
Once I transformed in front of them, everyone was convinced.

name: Lolotte
message: 「You beat Sengen'in-sensei to a pulp right in front of Azel-san? That would be what they call school violence.」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think that's quite right...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No wonder Azel-san got scared and ran away.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're merciless, aren't you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun is the Demon Loooooooord!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Did you seriously think it was a joke?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry for keeping quiet until no--」

name: Misa
message: 「A simple 'sorry' isn't going to cut it! What a massive betrayal!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Talking big like that, Misa--what would you do if you were suddenly told you were the Demon Lord one day!」

name: Misa
message: 「Why, of course! I would do my utmost to conduct myself in a manner befitting the Demon Lord!」

name: Ria
message: 「What is that supposed to mean?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you really do turn women into sweets and chop off the men's bits, don't you?」

name: Misa
message: 「I would never! Obviously, I would use the Demon Lord's power fairly and squarely for the sake of social justice!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn isn't using his Demon Lord powers to do anything bad either, you know!」

name: Misa
message: 「If it were me, I'd put them to much better use!」

name: Ria
message: 「I feel like we're getting off track here.」

name: Misa
message: 「Anyway! It's unforgivable that he kept something this huge a secret from the comrades he's fought alongside and pushed himself with!」

name: Synn
message: 「...So you're not mad about me being the Demon Lord?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm mad about that too!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just what I'd expect from my Student Council! From the Crusaders! This is exactly how things ought to be!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To think you'd already recruited the Demon Lord as an ally without me realizing! That's the best!」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You're awfully positive...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please call it leaning forward. It's even more forward-looking than just being positive.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're gonna trip and fall.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Someone terrifying as an enemy becomes worth a hundred men when they're on your side!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, if they're an ally, it's much easier to ambush them from behind.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a terrible ally.」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, you're actually more upset that Synn-kun hid it from you than the fact that he's the Demon Lord, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「...Uh, w-well... Yes. That's true, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... could I change back soon?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, sure, I'm satisfied. Though staying like that a little longer wouldn't...」

name: Paqy
message: 「He just awakened to it, so he gets worn out quick. Plus, Synn-sama's short on sleep.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, I'm getting dizzy...」

name: Ria
message: 「So a Demon Lord is... just like that...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't fly at Mach 3 or go on a rampage with a million horsepower?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. I can't fly.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How disappointing.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun is still Sakura-kun even after becoming a Demon Lord... Somehow, blaming you started feeling ridiculous.」
Phew....

name: Synn
message: 「Being normal sure is easy... wait, this isn't the time for that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We have to look for Azel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! Who cares about the Demon Lord!」

name: Misa
message: 「Didn't she just get scared after finding out there's a Demon Lord living under the same roof?」

name: Synn
message: 「So that really is it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If that were the case, she would've run away at the park, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Wasn't she just panicking at the park? She saw you defeat Sengen'in-sensei live, after all. Maybe she got scared once she got back to the apartment and calmed down.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's scared of me, huh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! Don't get depressed when nothing's even decided yet! And Misa, stop calling Synn a monster!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm speaking generally!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun. Do you have any idea where Azel-chan might have gone?」

name: Synn
message: 「The only place I can think of is Melilot-san's. But I already confirmed she didn't stay there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Running to the police... probably isn't happening, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even if she told them about a Demon Lord, nobody would take her seriously.」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder how much money Azel-chan has on her?」

name: Synn
message: 「Not that much...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then going back to her hometown is out of the question. The Duchy of Shabadaba, was it?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's the Principality of Sharo-Ma.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How ignorant of you, Vice President. Azel went back to Hea-- *ahem, cough*.」
Right. Azel was an angel who came here to investigate Re-Crea, wasn't she.
She doesn't have a home to return to in this world.
Did she go back to Heaven...

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-N-N-No, it's nothing!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「B-But, um, I don't think she went back to Hea--the Principality of Sharo-Ma. After all, it's super, super, suuuper far away.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, stop spacing out! We're going to be swamped from here on out! We have to pull off the Holy Night Festival preparations without a hitch while also finding Azel-san.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alrighty, let's split up and track her down nice and quick!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll tell the folks in the shopping district and the gang from the Delicious Food Squad to let us know if they spot her!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll casually pass the word along to Shio and the choir members as well.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll have Akane-chan help out. My big sister, too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I shall enlist Jiiya's cooperation. Jiiya is a true professional, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「So you see, Synn-kun, you don't have to worry all by yourself.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「One for all!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? What's the matter, everyone?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Say the second half too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course, we're going to make the Holy Night Festival a huge success, too!」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--Sakura-kun, why are you crying?! Th-This much is only natural!」
I'm glad I became the Student Council President with these guys.
As closing time arrives, Melilot locks the door.

name: Melilot
message: 「Please organize that shelf over there.」

name: Azel
message: 「G-Got it.」
Walking between the bookshelves, she puts the misplaced books back in their proper spots.

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone from the Student Council stopped by earlier.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Sorry for making you lie.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't worry about it. Even a hunter won't shoot a cornered bird that flies into his bosom, after all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's an old proverb. They're good people, aren't they.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I already know that.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun in particular came by five times.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Synn did.」
Azel's hands stopped.

name: Melilot
message: 「So, do you intend not to go back today either?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I can't go back.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then it can't be helped.」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you sure?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Though I can't offer much hospitality.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Just letting me stay is more than enough.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Also, I bought some pajamas for you, Azel-san. I hope they're to your liking.」

name: Azel
message: 「Huh... I feel bad taking that.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't mind it. I intended for it to be a gift.」

name: Melilot
message: 「With only a small bag like that, you didn't even bring a change of clothes, did you?」

name: Azel
message: 「I brought underwear.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And only that, right. I went ahead and bought a toothbrush and toothpaste too.」

name: Azel
message: 「Aren't you going to ask why.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please tell me whenever you feel like it.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Thanks.」
Melilot gave a small laugh.

name: Melilot
message: 「However, if you are going to tell me, please do so before the world ends.」

name: Azel
message: 「You know about it!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, it's merely a figure of speech.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Also, allow me to give you one piece of advice. If you do not wish to be found by the Student Council, you must not leave this place.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because a very capable friend of mine will likely join the search for you.」
